clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once handed a friend in Henderson, Nevada his Your Wish Is Your Command program. The guy listened to the whole thing in one night.

Eighteen months later: $4 million net. The part Kevin says matters most - 90 days of work, under 10 hours a week, then he stopped. The money kept coming every month after, no extra work needed.

That same friend built something even bigger: a glass bridge out over the Grand Canyon. Engineers and the government said it couldn't be done.

He built it anyway, and manifested it out of thin air.

What's the 'impossible' idea you've been told to drop?
